surface_mechanism_description: Selenium was incorporated into the films by substituting surface sulfur with elemental selenium, avoiding the use of toxic H2Se and organometallic selenium compounds. The substitution reaction proceeds according to reaction Eq. (1), and the sulfur-to-selenium ratio on the surface can be varied using different Se pulse lengths.
evidence: In this work, selenium was incorporated into the films by substituting surface sulfur with elemental selenium, thus avoiding a use of the toxic H2Se and organometallic selenium compounds that are commonly used in chemical vapor deposition method (CVD). Thermochemical calculations suggest that the substitution reaction proceeds according to reaction Eq. (1), and the sulfur-to-selenium ratio on the surface can be varied using different Se pulse lengths.
